name: supply-chlorine-stopgap
narrative: Ngozi runs supply for the Safe Water Programme, and she starts at the checks, where ClearWater Action's donated chlorine is ninety days past the date it was promised and the Sahel CHI store in Kano that refills the dispensers sits under its two-month floor. She opens the donation and reads it as ClearWater gave it: in kind, nothing to pay, 400 jerry cans still to arrive. Instead of chasing ClearWater again, she points an alert at their supply desk's email, so the store falling below its minimum or their shipment passing its date reaches them straight from the record. For a stop-gap she has asked Harmattan Health Supplies for nationally registered chlorine, and she checks their quote: Aquaguard at 1.25%, 90 jerry cans within a week, the product's registration certificate filed beside the quotation. She awards the stop-gap to Harmattan and writes down why. She records the regulator's approval on the award, citing that registration certificate. She asks Northstar Fund, which pays for the programme, to approve the spend. When she tries to place the order before Northstar has answered, the order screen refuses it and names Northstar's pending approval. Northstar says yes, Ngozi records their answer, and the same order goes through. When the jerry cans reach Kano she records Sahel CHI's goods received note, and the 90 cans enter the store's ledger. The store's cover rises but stays under its floor: the stop-gap bridges the gap, and ClearWater's donation is still what Kano is waiting on. On the alerts page Ngozi sees that ClearWater's supply desk has already been emailed both facts, the store below its minimum and their shipment overdue, and decides the next chase can wait for their reply.

ngozi.intro: Ngozi keeps chlorine in the community dispensers across Kano, and this morning the donor's consignment is three months late and the store is running down.

features.description: contract_delivery_overdue fires when signed_on plus promised_lead_time_days has passed and the contract is not fully received, carrying days_late, expected_on and the supplier.
features.verify: pytest connect_labs/supply_chain/tests -k contract_delivery_overdue asserts days_late and expected_on in the facts

features.description: shipment_overdue fires for a shipment whose expected_on has passed with no receipt and status not delivered or lost.
features.verify: Playwright: /supply/checks/ shows 'Shipment past its expected date' with 'days late' 90 for CWA-DON-2026-02/1

features.description: stock_below_minimum fires when a supply point's months of stock is under its own min_months_of_stock.
features.verify: Playwright: /supply/checks/ lists 'Below its own minimum' for the Sahel CHI Kano chlorine store with min months of stock 2

scenes.narrative: Ngozi starts at the checks, where ClearWater Action's donated chlorine is ninety days past the date it was promised and the Sahel CHI store in Kano that refills the dispensers sits under its two-month floor.
scenes.title: ClearWater's chlorine is ninety days late and Kano is running low

features.description: Contract.consideration in_kind makes landed_total report "not purchased (in kind)" for every line and keeps the contract out of contract_cost_unconfirmed.
features.verify: pytest connect_labs/supply_chain/tests -k in_kind asserts landed cost reads not purchased and no contract_cost_unconfirmed check

features.description: The order page badges an in-kind contract "In kind — donated" and shows ordered, received and outstanding quantities.
features.verify: Playwright: /supply/orders/<id>/ shows 'In kind — donated' and 'Still outstanding 400 jerry_can'

scenes.narrative: She opens the donation and reads it as ClearWater gave it: in kind, nothing to pay, 400 jerry cans still to arrive.
scenes.title: The donation owes nothing but its arrival

features.description: /supply/alerts/new/ offers every check kind as a checkbox, a supply point and product filter, and a recipient choice of me or an email address.
